pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, stellate polygons with serrated edges exhibiting soft pixel-level gradients. High variance in spatial area between individual patches.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with frequent multi-way junctions. Thickness is variable, appearing wider in the mid-flank region compared to the cervical area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane displays a continuous, low-amplitude serrated profile along the dorsal silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Avian organism (oxpecker) is perched on the dorsal midline near the neck-shoulder transition.
